info.title: Rust global static runtime initialization setup

diffs.patch:
Index: Cargo.lock
===================================================================
--- Cargo.lock	
+++ Cargo.lock	
@@ -0,0 +1,7 @@
+# This file is automatically @generated by Cargo.
+# It is not intended for manual editing.
+version = 4
+
+[[package]]
+name = "runtime-global"
+version = "0.1.0"

parts.text: "Set up a new Rust project for an app that needs a global static value whose initialization requires runtime computation rather than a compile-time constant."

The user wants a new Rust project with a global static value initialized at runtime. Let me set it up. The idiomatic solutions: `std::sync::OnceLock` (Rust 1.70+) or `lazy_static`/`once_cell`. Since they asked to set up a project, let me create it.

Let me check the environment first.
Cargo isn't installed. Let me check for rustup or install. Let me look around.
